carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.h: Harrell Leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a Defense Full of Questions
carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] is leaving [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] after going 19-19 to take over a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] program that is 0-1. The Cardinal job comes with a bigger name and a much bigger rebuild, starting with the secondary.

quote.text: He wanted a bigger stage, and he knows what he's walking into on defense. Nobody there is under any illusions.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

561119626battle.h: Ole Miss holds the lead for Wilds, but Texas won't back off
561119626battle.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has the edge for five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with [[t:832438384|Texas]] right behind and Oklahoma still in the mix. Wilds wants a title contender, and sources say he is weighing who is likeliest to win one.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually winning it all?
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

561121675battle.h: Missouri clings to a slim lead over Indiana for Favre
561121675battle.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] is ahead for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], but Indiana has closed hard and Michigan is lurking. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and Missouri's staff has reportedly been working to make that case.

quote.text: Indiana has changed the way his family talks about this. It's a real race now.
quote.by: a person familiar with Favre's thinking

561125724battle.h: Clemson leads for Coburn, but home-state pull could swing it to Alabama
561125724battle.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has the advantage for five-star [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] is a short drive from Coral Springs. Ole Miss is also lurking.

quote.text: His mom keeps saying she wants to see him play on Saturdays. That matters.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561121494battle.h: Georgia leads Miami for Yeast, but playing time is the wild card
561121494battle.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] holds the edge for five-star receiver [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]]. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has been selling an immediate role and has not backed down, and Florida State is lurking. Georgia's staff is reportedly feeling it.

quote.text: He doesn't want to wait his turn. Whoever shows him the field wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561120536battle.h: Notre Dame's national spotlight is working on Longo
561120536battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] leads for five-star receiver [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], with [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and Oklahoma close behind. Longo wants national exposure, and Notre Dame offers plenty of it. Official visits could decide this one.

quote.text: He loves the idea of playing on that stage every Saturday.

561121938battle.h: Texas Holds Edge for Simonson, but Tennessee and USC Aren't Going Away
561121938battle.d: [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]] has Texas in front, Tennessee close behind and USC still in the picture. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and the Longhorns are benefiting from it. One more big week could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the league he'll be playing in. That's the first thing he brings up every time we talk.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

557714489:underpaid.h: B.Bouye Is an 87-Overall Back With No NIL Deal. Is SMU the Answer?
557714489:underpaid.d: [[p:557714489|B.Bouye]] has no NIL money, while running backs at his level get around 85K. Collectives are lining up, and [[t:832438375|SMU]] is a name coming up in the chatter. Running backs with this production don't stay unpaid for long once the portal opens.

quote.text: A back like that doesn't sit on the market. The first serious offer is probably the one he takes.

557719687:underpaid.h: Texas Receiver T.Bada Is Producing Like a Star and Earning Nothing
557719687:underpaid.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] is an 87-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while comparable receivers get around 90K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has one of the deepest collectives in the country, but rivals are already calling.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The only question is whether Texas fixes it before somebody else does.

557727130:underpaid.h: E.Udoh Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
557727130:underpaid.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver with no NIL money, while receivers at his level get around 105K. Collectives know the gap well, and one source says he has already heard from several of them.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he knows the market. His phone isn't quiet.
quote.by: a person familiar with his situation

561121140battle.h: Texas Tech edges Texas for Wolf in a tight playing-time fight
561121140battle.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has a slim lead for five-star corner [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]], with Ole Miss lurking. Wolf cares about early snaps, and both staffs have pitched him a quick path to the field.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to who lets him start as a freshman.

561119899commit.h: Stanford Lands Durante, a California Safety Who Wanted to Start
561119899commit.d: Stanford sold the three-star strong safety on a chance to compete right away. For a pass defense that has been a problem, that pitch carries weight. Durante is staying close to home, and his family played a role.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

557718419:underpaid.h: Rashed Is an 88-Overall Safety on a Bargain Deal. [[t:832438288|BYU]] Could Pounce.
557718419:underpaid.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]] makes 65K while safeties of his caliber get around 140K. Rival collectives have noticed, and [[t:832438288|BYU]] is the name being floated as a team willing to close that gap.

quote.text: You don't leave an 88 at that number for long. Somebody's going to make a call, and the player knows it.

831914385:upset.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls to Nebraska and the bracket takes a hit
831914385:upset.d: The top-ranked team in the country lost to Nebraska despite moving the ball. Tuddy_roosevelt's team had the yards and still left with a loss. Per a source close to the program, the mood in the building afterward was ugly.

quote.text: We did everything but finish. That's what's eating guys up.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

831914385:4th:832438348.h: Nebraska's fourth-down aggression broke Ohio State in a 28-25 win
831914385:4th:832438348.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] converted 3 of 4 fourth-down tries, and each one seemed to drain a little more out of the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] defense. A Buckeyes staffer admitted the sideline went quiet after the second conversion.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there, you could feel our guys deflate.

557719266:underpaid.h: Trueblood is a bargain at Tennessee, but rival collectives are circling
557719266:underpaid.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is an 89-overall guard making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 190K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the fourth-deepest NIL pockets nationally, but rival collectives have noticed.

quote.text: A guard that good at that price won't stay quiet for long.

557719074:fit.h: Neighbors may be a bad fit in Ohio State's offense
557719074:fit.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] is a 91-overall receiver on a team ranked 125th of 138 in receptions. After the Nebraska loss, a source says other programs are already sniffing around.

quote.text: He's a playmaker who isn't getting the ball. Guys like that start listening.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713038:fit.h: Lyle could hit the portal if Ohio State's passing game stays stuck
557713038:fit.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]], a 90-overall pocket passer, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] offense ranked 130th of 138 in passing yards per game. The loss to Nebraska only fueled the chatter about his future.

quote.text: He wants to throw the ball. Right now that's not the offense.
quote.by: a person close to the QB room

557717760:fit.h: Blunt's future at Ohio State is murky as the run game sputters
557717760:fit.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]], an 88-overall back, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] team ranked 127th of 138 in rushing yards per game. A back who seeks contact wants carries, and the scheme isn't giving him many.

quote.text: He's built to run downhill. The offense isn't set up for it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718710:underpaid.h: Boger is underpaid, and Wake Forest may have to pay up
557718710:underpaid.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 84-overall quarterback making 65K, while players at his position and rating command around 160K. That gap tends to close in the portal. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] needs to decide how much he's worth.

quote.text: Somebody's going to pay him. It's just a matter of who calls first.

831914108:upset.h: Syracuse stuns Texas, and rival recruiters smell blood
831914108:upset.d: The Longhorns were ranked 16th and got outgained and outmuscled at home by [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Rival staffs chasing Texas targets are already working the phones, per a source.

quote.text: You can't sell 'national contender' the week after that tape goes around.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

831914715:int:557725897.h: A.Renda's six-interception disaster leaves Mississippi State searching for answers
831914715:int:557725897.d: [[p:557725897|A.Renda]] kept throwing into traffic and [[t:832438381|TCU]] kept collecting. Teammates were short on words afterward, and the quarterback room may not stay quiet for long, a source said.

quote.text: He kept trying to make one big play. We needed him to take the easy one.
quote.by: a source close to the Mississippi State program

831914025:4th:832438287.h: Buffalo's fourth-down obsession burns it, and the fan base is livid
831914025:4th:832438287.d: [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] kept the offense on the field and kept coming up empty against [[t:832438370|Rutgers]]. Boosters are grumbling that the staff trusted the chalkboard over its own kicker.

quote.text: Take the points once in a while. Nobody gets fired for taking the points.

831914108:int:557713620.h: R.Crum's three picks put Texas's quarterback spot under the microscope
831914108:int:557713620.d: [[p:557713620|R.Crum]] gave the ball away three times in the upset loss to [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Sources say the staff will spend the week deciding how much patience is left.

quote.text: Nobody in that building is pointing fingers, but everybody saw the tape.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas program

831914715:pass:557716196.h: L.Connors turns Mississippi State's secondary into target practice
831914715:pass:557716196.d: [[p:557716196|L.Connors]] threw for six touchdowns as [[t:832438381|TCU]] rolled to a 61-14 win over [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. NFL-minded scouts in the press box were taking notes.

831914452:comeback.h: Coastal Carolina storms back in the fourth against an FCS Midwest foe
831914452:comeback.d: [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] trailed 27-13 entering the final quarter, then won it 17-0. The sideline got loud, and a halftime message apparently didn't land until the third quarter ended.

quote.text: We stopped waiting for something to happen and made it happen.

831914792:comeback.h: West Virginia erases a fourth-quarter hole to beat NC State in a 52-49 thriller
831914792:comeback.d: [[t:832438410|West Virginia]] trailed 41-28 after three quarters and won the last one 24-8. [[t:832438347|NC State]] let it slip, and its coaches may spend the week fielding questions about the closing defense.

quote.text: That's a locker room that does not quit. Period.
quote.by: a source close to the West Virginia program

831914030:comeback.h: Wyoming rallies past UTEP after trailing entering the fourth
831914030:comeback.d: [[t:832438414|Wyoming]] trailed 35-24 after three and outscored [[t:832438402|UTEP]] 17-3 down the stretch. The defense found itself late, and the sideline credited a halftime adjustment.

831914737:comeback.h: New Mexico State shuts out an FCS East team in the fourth to steal it
831914737:comeback.d: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]] trailed 21-10 after three quarters and won the fourth 21-0. A booster at the game said the energy in the stadium flipped when the defense got a stop.

quote.text: You could feel it change. Nobody wanted to be the one who blinked.

831914203:4th:832438363.h: Ole Miss refuses to punt, converts every fourth down in 52-13 rout
831914203:4th:832438363.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] went 4-for-4 on fourth down against [[t:832438365|Oregon State]], a statement that can't hurt with elite recruits watching. Word is the staff sold that aggression on visits this week.

quote.text: That's the program we're building. We play to win.
quote.by: a source close to the Ole Miss program

831914784:4th:832438406.h: Virginia Tech's fourth-down math doesn't survive contact with Arizona
831914784:4th:832438406.d: [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438276|Arizona]]. The numbers crowd will argue it was right, but the fan base has stopped listening.

quote.text: It's fine until it fails, and it failed three times.

831914312:rush:557716795.h: Stockton scores four times and gives Penn State's run game a lift
831914312:rush:557716795.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] ran through contact all afternoon, breaking seven tackles on the way to four touchdowns. That helps agerm40 answer the rushing questions, and it will make Stockton's name pop up on rival staffs' radar.

quote.text: He runs angry. Once he starts, you can't tackle him with one guy.

831914593:pass:557712048.h: J.Landry throws for 411 yards and still loses to Texas Tech
831914593:pass:557712048.d: [[p:557712048|J.Landry]] did everything he could, but [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] escaped 35-33. Texas Tech's staff will take the win, and Landry's team will wonder how a monster day ended in a loss.

quote.text: We left too many points out there. That's on all of us.

831914117:def:557724765.h: K.Hayward's three interceptions power Iowa's 49-19 win over Florida Atlantic
831914117:def:557724765.d: [[p:557724765|K.Hayward]] grabbed three passes against [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]], making him the player opposing offensive coordinators will be talking about this week.

831914718:ot.h: Sacramento State survives an overtime scare, 21-14
831914718:ot.d: [[t:832438371|Sacramento State]] needed the extra period to beat an FCS West opponent, taking overtime 7-0. A source said the postgame locker room was more relief than celebration.

831914440:flags:832438281.h: Auburn's ten penalties hand Miami the game
831914440:flags:832438281.d: [[t:832438281|Auburn]] kept shooting itself in the foot against [[t:832438337|Miami]], and the coaches weren't happy. Expect a punishing week of practice for the Tigers.

quote.text: Practice is going to be a lot less fun this week.

831914673:flags:832438357.h: Notre Dame's ten penalties leave a bad look against Indiana
831914673:flags:832438357.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] lost its composure and the loss to [[t:832438319|Indiana]] followed. A prime-time stage was supposed to help the Irish pitch recruits, and instead rival staffs are already using the tape.

quote.text: That's the kind of film other programs love to show a recruit.

831914408:rec:557727821.h: D.Melton can't be stopped, torches Central Michigan for four scores
831914408:rec:557727821.d: [[p:557727821|D.Melton]] saw bracket coverage and made it irrelevant. Bigger programs are expected to check on his situation, per a source.

quote.text: He's a different tier. You can't scheme him out of a game.

831914210:int:557717973.h: J.Daly throws three picks, but San Jose State escapes UTSA
831914210:int:557717973.d: [[p:557717973|J.Daly]] threw for two touchdowns and three interceptions in a shaky win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]]. His coach was reportedly not thrilled with the decision-making in the second half.

quote.text: We won, but he knows he has to be cleaner.
quote.by: a source close to the San Jose State program

831914905:shutout.h: Minnesota blanks an FCS East opponent, 17-0, and the offense never got a first down
831914905:shutout.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] didn't just win, it made the opposition's afternoon a disaster. The defense dominated from the first series, per a source.

831914701:def:557724775.h: D.Tuman wrecks UAB's opponent with three sacks in a 38-14 win
831914701:def:557724775.d: [[p:557724775|D.Tuman]] lived in the backfield all game. Scouts were already comparing his burst to an NFL edge rusher, a source said.

quote.text: Every time I looked up, 94 was already there.

831914582:def:557717959.h: K.Huntley picks off Washington State twice in a loss
831914582:def:557717959.d: [[p:557717959|K.Huntley]] played a monster game that his team couldn't turn into a win against [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. His teammates were frustrated that the defense did everything but win.

quote.text: I did my job. That doesn't help if we lose.

831914860:3rd:832438356.h: Northwestern can't move the chains and loses to Texas A&M
831914860:3rd:832438356.d: [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] went 2-for-13 on third down, and the play-calling is going to take heat. A source said some players were unhappy with the plan.

quote.text: We kept running into the same wall. Nothing changed.

831914216:blowout.h: Baylor flattens an FCS West opponent, 51-7
831914216:blowout.d: [[t:832438283|Baylor]] piled up 532 yards and let the starters watch the end. The Bears' coach was reportedly happy with the effort.

831914773:blowout.d: [[t:832438393|UCF]] gained 553 yards and had the game decided early. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] will be looking for answers on defense.

831914885:blowout.h: Virginia drops 59 on an FCS West opponent, winning 59-10
831914885:blowout.d: [[t:832438405|Virginia]] rolled up 520 yards and looked like the better team from the opening drive. Staffers said they liked the tempo.

quote.text: That's what a statement looks like.

831914614:rec:557723324.h: G.Heeney leaves USF's secondary chasing shadows with three touchdowns
831914614:rec:557723324.d: [[p:557723324|G.Heeney]] caught seven passes and scored three times against [[t:832438399|USF]]. The USF cornerbacks are still looking for answers.

quote.text: He was open every time we blinked.

831914829:rec:557726535.h: M.Vitti scores three times as bracket coverage fails against an FCS East team
831914829:rec:557726535.d: [[p:557726535|M.Vitti]] caught seven passes and made every defensive adjustment look useless. Sources said opponents were already game-planning around him.
